title: Structural section formula and coherent etale pullback map
statement: For a scheme morphism g:Y→X and quasi-coherent modules F on X and G on Y, use their lifted associated etale sheaves [def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison]. For a module morphism psi:g*F→G and a sheaf morphism theta:F_et→g_*G_et, HasQcoherentPullbackSectionFormula is exactly the assertion that every section ULift.up s on every etale U maps to ULift.up of qcoherentPullbackSection(g,F,G,psi,U,U×_X Y,pr,condition,s) [lem-weil-pbc-qcoherent-pullback-sections-map]. Construct coherentEtalePullbackMap on degree-q cohomology as cohomologyMap(g) [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] followed by H.map of the adjunct of theta. Prove an equivalence exposing the full section formula and an equation evaluating the constructed map. No choice, compactness, affine, separatedness or vanishing assumption is used. Equality of module coefficient morphisms preserves the section-formula proposition by substitution.

source.place: Tags 03Q8 and 03DR, structural pullback on sections; Tag 03FD, the induced map on cohomology.

proof.text: Define a proposition structure whose sole field is the stated universal equation on sections. Projection and construction prove the equivalence exposing that equation. Define the cohomology function by the prescribed composite through the upper-star/lower-star adjunction. Its evaluation equation is reflexivity after unfolding. The constructions cover empty etale objects, zero modules, identity arrows, and q=0; the equations impose exactly the displayed original formula. Equality substitution in the named proposition proves coefficient congruence without rewriting its full quantified equation.
